rubric.grammar: 0: unreadable/broken; 1: understandable with awkward or incomplete clauses; 2: natural complete Japanese. Score language separately from factual correctness.
rubric.relevance: 0: unrelated/contradicts the request; 1: partly relevant or vague; 2: directly responds to the final User in the actual history. Do not require literal gold wording.
rubric.context: 0: loses or contradicts required conditions; 1: partial/ambiguous retention; 2: retains all relevant conditions and corrections in the actual history. For own-history use generated replies, never supplied gold Assistant messages.
rubric.rationale: At least 12 characters explaining the particular response. Keep fantasy, alternate natural answers, numeric correctness, grammar, and stopping distinct.
